findings.passage: A covered voter voting under this Article shall not be required to include a photocopy of identification described in G.S. 163-166.16(a) or an affidavit as described in G.S. 163-166.16(d)(1), (d)(2), or (d)(3) when submitting a ballot in accordance with this Article.
findings.note: Crawford is named in the sponsor list of HB 278 and the bill appears on her introduced-bills page (https://www.ncleg.gov/Members/IntroducedBills/H/800). It adds G.S. 163-258.21, so a covered military or overseas voter would not have to include a photocopy of ID, or the listed affidavits, when submitting a ballot. It was referred to the House Rules committee on 03/05/2025 and has no further action listed.
